_comment: Regression guard only — NOT an accuracy claim. This records whatever the engine outputs today for each approved_unit_count fixture AND each holdout:true fixture, so an UNINTENDED change gets caught on either set. A number matching this baseline says nothing about how close it is to the real scheme's count (see the ERROR% column scorecard.ts itself prints, and test-sites/README.md's honest accounting of it) — only that nothing changed since the last deliberate, explained update. A hold-out fixture's own number must NEVER be chased by changing an engine parameter — see each such fixture's own 'held-out' framing in test-sites/README.md.
